title: Italian-Irish heritage, church and a band of Italians
summary: Talk of Ed DeBarra, a band of mostly Italians, his Italian father and Irish mother, Catholic upbringing and no jazzed church music.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular
